title: Content Discovery: Forgotten Artifacts
summary: Discover what a web root should not expose: robots.txt breadcrumbs, an exposed .git/config, and a leftover .bak backup, then chain the recovered tokens into a final proof.
description: A standalone web content-discovery lab. A synthetic archive portal leaks internal paths through robots.txt, an accidentally published .git directory, and a stale backup file. All hosts, tokens, and flags are synthetic and live only on an internal Docker network.

services.name: web-archive
services.purpose: Web root that exposes forgotten artifacts
